name: Encoder
description: Encode and decode Base64, Base32, Hex, URL, HTML entities and Unicode escapes, and turn files into Base64 / Data URIs, plus Base58, Base85, Ascii85 and Morse code
help: Pick an encoding on the left and switch between encode and decode above; results update as you type.
Decoded data that is not UTF-8 text (such as image bytes) is shown as hex with a notice.
“Swap” moves the output back to the input and flips the direction so you can verify a round trip.
File to Base64 runs as a background task (up to 20 MB) and can produce a Data URI ready for HTML / CSS.

Base58 uses the Bitcoin alphabet; Base85 uses the RFC 1924 / git alphabet, and Ascii85 is wrapped in <~ ~> with z for four zero bytes. Morse follows ITU; characters without a code (such as Chinese) can be sent as UTF-8 hex first (decoding gives hex, then decode it with Hex).
